summary: Android system Back now dismisses an open mobile navigation or members drawer instead of popping the workspace route and sending the app to the launcher.

checks.name: Regression widget tests on Android and iOS configurations
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'mobile edge swipes open and close both workspace panels'
checks.observation: Both platform cases open each drawer, dispatch system Back, and verify the drawer closes while WorkspaceScreen remains mounted.

checks.name: Release APK build
checks.observation: Signed 107.8 MB APK built. Build-number override was used only to update the already installed CI build 1.0.9+2013; repository version was not changed.

checks.name: Pixel 7 drawer and system Back acceptance
checks.command: adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk; adb shell input tap 200 220; adb shell input keyevent 4; adb shell input swipe 980 1200 700 1200 250; adb shell input keyevent 4
checks.observation: The channel drawer opened from its visible menu control; Android Back closed it and the app remained foreground. A right-edge swipe opened the members drawer; Android Back closed it and the app remained foreground. Accessibility snapshots confirmed the expected drawer labels before each Back. No channel, voice, or message state was changed.

remaining: Physical acceptance on iOS and broader Android combined drawer/channel/dock flows remain open in QA-78 and QA-79.
